sourceNote: Experiments preserve source hashes captured at their start. Afterwards only diagnostic bagComposition was added to the simulator; the runner gained sell mode between experiments. No production combat/economy rule changed in this block.

policies.none: Starter only; retain all earned resources.
policies.skill: Purchase slot 1 ranks as soon as affordable with earned gold/dust.
policies.equipment: Equip conservative nonnegative-stat suggestions; refine equipped weapon to +2 with earned stones/gold.
policies.fusion: Reserve resources for first compatible weapon fusion, purchase once and attempt to equip it.

assumptions.limitations: Sequential deterministic solo samples, not live-player behaviour or endgame balance. Identical starting seeds; decisions can change subsequent RNG use. No inventory expansion, recycling, manual sales or build selection. Balance milestones describe unspent current balances, not cumulative lifetime earnings. Initial potions and 50 gold are the normal character starter kit.
